memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Osteoarthritis of both knees.
Patient reports aching pain in knees worsened by stair climbing and prolonged standing; mild crepitus on bilateral knee examination, no effusion, range of motion slightly limited. Spirometry: FEV1 2.10 L (85% predicted), FVC 2.58 L, FEV1/FVC 0.81, change since prior +0.05 L. Asthma Control Test score 22 (well controlled). Technique checked: correct salbutamol metered-dose inhaler use. Smoking status: former, 30 pack-years, stopped 2005.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Paracetamol 650 mg SOS
Diclofenac gel 1% apply to affected knee BD
Calcium carbonate 500 mg + Vitamin D3 400 IU OD

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Weight-bearing X-ray both knees: Joint space narrowing medially, marginal osteophytes, mild subchondral sclerosis; no significant dislocation.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow-up appointment booked for 2025-07-10 at 10:30 with Dr Suresh Menon (D05).
